title: More than beautiful
text: More than beautiful. Omgosh! I got my mugs today and to my surprise ! They are three x’s better looking in person , they feel great and handles are large and comfy , can’t wait to wash and put some tea or coffee or whatever . I absolutely love these, I going to give ( in future) as gifts. ❤️❤️❤️

product_metadata.title: DeeCoo Set of 4 , 15 Ounce Ceramic Coffee Mugs Restaurant Coffee Mug, Large-sized Black Coffee Mugs Set Perfect for Coffee, latte, Cappuccino, Tea, Cocoa, Cereal, Hot Chocolate
features: SOUP MUG: Holding a full 15 ounces(without filling it to the very top).This large coffee mug perfect for cappuccinos/latte, cereal, soup, ice cream, snacks, salads, rice dishes.The ultimate mug and bowl in one!

CREATIVE DESIGN JUMBO MUG: Made with high-fire ceramic, this mug has creative design, fun creatures in the cup inside that are slowly revealed as you drink. ideal gift for friends, family, and mermaid lovers.
PERFECT SIZE HANDLE: The ultimate mug and bowl in one! Made of beautiful white porcelain. The comfortable handle and perfect shape make it easy to enjoy every spoonful.

PRO-GRADE PORCELAIN & SAFE FOR DISHWASHER, MICROWAVE, OVEN AND FREEZER : These DeeCoo mugs are made of durable porcelain, a type of premium LEAD-FREE and NON-TOXIC ceramic, chip-resistant and more sturdy than stoneware.

IDEAL GIFT: These DeeCoo large handmade coffee mugs are packaged in a well-wrapped box, a special gift for your friends and family on Housewarming, Wedding party, Mothers' Day, Fathers' Day, Christmas and New Year's Day.
